fayvara1_0.m: Hello again, my friend. I hope that the things I have taught you have proven to be useful.

fayvara1_1.m: There you are! I had hoped to see you again after you helped me up in the Charwood heights!

fayvara1_10.m: We very rarely teach anyone outside our settlement, Falothen and I. I heard that Falothen taught someone a while ago and I heard that he was given five Oegyth crystals and {5000} gold in return.

fayvara1_11.m: So I'm thinking something similar would suffice. Since as you're my friend, I won't charge as much as Falothen did but our settlement really needs the coin. Two of those crystals and {6000} gold should be well enough.
r: I don't have that on me right now. I'll be back.
I think I should hold on to those crystals some more.

fayvara1_12.m: Yes, those things sure are valuable.

fayvara1_13q.m: It seems you do not have enough gold. {6000} gold it is.

fayvara1_14.m: Which type of armor are you interested in?
r: Tell me more about light armor.
Tell me more about heavy armor.
Tell me more about fighting without armor.

fayvara1_2.m: Thank you so much for helping to get me free! The stench of those monsters up there was awful.

fayvara1_2nd_h0.m: Heavy armor, for when you really need protection. They generally provide the best protection around, making you withstand most attacks from your opponent without even getting a scratch.

fayvara1_2nd_h1.m: The downside is of course that they weigh a lot, which can slow you down. I can teach you how you can use that to your advantage, so that you can withstand attacks better and not be as slowed down as you would otherwise.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about heavy armors. Here are two Oegyth crystals and {6000} gold as payment.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_2nd_h3.m: [Fayvara teaches you the heavy armor skill]

fayvara1_2nd_l0.m: Light armor comes in many varieties. From the simple leather armor to the light-weight steel ones. Compared to the heavy armors, you can generally be more flexible when using them, sometimes even increasing your movement speed.

fayvara1_2nd_l1.m: I can teach you how to better block blows while wearing light armor, so that you don't get hit as often.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about light armors. Here are two Oegyth crystals and {6000} gold as payment.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_2nd_l3.m: [Fayvara teaches you the light armor skill]

fayvara1_2nd_no.m: I've already taught you that skill.
r: Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_2nd_s0.m: Shields can be used in combination with your regular weapon, to block attacks from your opponent.

fayvara1_2nd_s1.m: I can teach you to better withstand attacks using a shield, so that you don't take as much damage while using them.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about shields. Here are two Oegyth crystals and {6000} gold as payment.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_2nd_u0.m: Ah yes, the pure of mind do not need physical protection. As you know, wearing armor may slow you down - and by learning how to fight without wearing any, you can become even faster.

fayvara1_2nd_u1.m: I can teach you the way of fighting without armor and how you can use that to your advantage so you don't get hit as often.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about unarmored combat. Here are two Oegyth crystals and {6000} gold as payment.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_2nd_u3.m: [Fayvara teaches you the unarmored combat skill]

fayvara1_3.m: I don't have much to give you in return, apart from my knowledge of how to use different kinds of armors. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

fayvara1_4.m: I can teach you how to better handle most types of armors, so that you can get even more proficient while wearing them.
r: What armor types can you teach me?

fayvara1_5.m: I can teach you about using shields and parrying weapons to your advantage, or how to best use light or heavy armors. I can also teach you how to better handle blows when not wearing any armor at all - fighting unarmored, that is.

fayvara1_6.m: We only have time for one type of armor right now though, so think carefully on which one will suit you best.
r: Tell me more about shields and parrying weapons.
Tell me more about light armor.
Tell me more about heavy armor.
Tell me more about fighting without armor.

fayvara1_7_h.m: Heavy armor, for when you really need protection. They generally provide the best protection around, making you withstand most attacks from your opponent without even getting a scratch.

fayvara1_7_h1.m: The downside is of course that they weigh a lot, which can slow you down. I can teach you how you can use that to your advantage, so that you can withstand attacks better and not be as slowed down as you would otherwise.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about heavy armors.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

r: Sounds good. Teach me about light armors.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_7_l2.m: [Fayvara teaches you the light armor skill]

fayvara1_7_s.m: Shields can be used in combination with your regular weapon, to block attacks from your opponent. Parrying weapons are mainly defensive, and can be use to block or divert your opponents strike. They will not block as well as a good shield, but if you know how to use them they can be very effective, and you may be able to do some damage with them.

fayvara1_7_s1.m: I can teach you to better withstand attacks using a shield, or to divert blows using a parrying weapon, so that you don't take as much damage while using them.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about shields and parrying weapons.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_7_u.m: Ah yes, the pure of mind do not need physical protection. As you know, wearing armor may slow you down - and by learning how to fight without wearing any, you can become even faster.

fayvara1_7_u1.m: I can teach you the way of fighting without armor and how you can use that to your advantage so you don't get hit as often.
r: Sounds good. Teach me about unarmored combat.
Let's go back to the other types of armors.

fayvara1_7_u2.m: [Fayvara teaches you the unarmored combat skill]

fayvara1_8.m: Well done. I hope that will be useful for you.

fayvara1_9.m: I can of course teach you the other types of armors as well, if you want. Seeing as how I already taught you once for free, I will require payment for teaching you further.

charwood1.10: I heard a rumor that some mining town in the Charwood forest, northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern, has had some troubles recently. I should try to find the Charwood cabin and find out what has happened.
charwood1.11: I heard someone mention that the mining town of Charwood heights has had some troubles recently. I should search for the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern.
charwood1.19: I have found the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern.
charwood1.20: Maevalia in the Charwood cabin told me a story about how their mining settlement was attacked by some monsters, forcing them to flee down the mountain. They are still missing several of their friends and relatives from the Charwood heights, either killed or captured by the monsters.
charwood1.21: In particular, Maevalia mentions four people that are greatly missed; their former leader Morenavia, their weapons trainer Falothen, the healer Ayell and their armorer Fayvara.
charwood1.30: I have agreed to help the people of Charwood find their missing people.
charwood1.35: The guard outside the Charwood cabin allowed me to enter the hills ahead. I should keep to the east and then head north.
charwood1.40: I encountered one of the monsters that Maevalia spoke of. The monster spoke of someone or something called 'The Thukuzun'.
charwood1.41: I have found Falothen, the weapons trainer of the Charwood heights, and freed him from the restraints that held him. He will try to make his way back to the Charwood cabin himself.
charwood1.42: I have found some skeletal remains, containing a ring with the insignia 'Morenavia'. This must be the former leader of the Charwood hills.
charwood1.43: I have found the armorer Fayvara, and freed her from the restraints that held her. She will try to make her way back to the Charwood cabin herself.
charwood1.44: I have found some skeletal remains, containing a ring with the insignia 'Ayell'. This must be the remains of the Charwood hills healer that Maevalia mentioned.
charwood1.50: Maevalia thanked me for finding out what happened to the four people that she told me about, but was really sad to hear about the fate of Morenavia and Ayell. Both the weapons trainer Falothen and the armorer Fayvara made it back to the Charwood cabin safely.
charwood1.60: She told me that both Falothen and Fayvara are anxious to see me, in the basement of the Charwood cabin. I should go see them at once.
charwood1.65: Falothen was happy to see me again, and in return offered to train me in better handling of one weapon type. He can teach me better handling of one or two handed swords, daggers, blunt weapons, axes, or unarmed combat. I'll have to chose my preference and let him know.
charwood1.70: Falothen has taught me how to better handle one handed swords.
charwood1.71: Falothen has taught me how to better handle two handed swords.
charwood1.72: Falothen has taught me how to better handle daggers.
charwood1.73: Falothen has taught me how to better handle blunt weapons.
charwood1.74: Falothen has taught me how to better handle axes.
charwood1.75: Falothen has taught me how to be better at fighting unarmed, without weapons.
charwood1.76: Falothen has taught me how to better handle polearms.
charwood1.80: Falothen offered me the chance to learn about the other weapon types, but to teach me, he needs 5000 gold and two Oegyth crystals for each skill that I want to get better at.
charwood1.90: Fayvara thanked me for rescuing her, and in return offered to train me in better handling of one type of armor. She can teach me better handling of shields, light armor, heavy armor or or unarmored combat. I'll have to chose my preference and let her know.
charwood1.91: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle shields.
charwood1.92: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle light armor.
charwood1.93: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle heavy armor.
charwood1.94: Fayvara has taught me how to better fighting unarmored, without wearing any armor.
charwood1.100: Fayvara offered me the chance to learn about the other armor types, but to teach me, she needs 6000 gold and two Oegyth crystals for each skill that I want to get better at.
charwood1.110: I have been taught one weapon type skill and one armor type skill from Falothen and Fayvara. I should go see Maevalia again.
charwood1.115: Maevalia thanked me for helping the people of Charwood.
